如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    第二天，无言洗漱过后，就走出了旅馆。
说实在的，其实无言更希望没有在这个旅馆上住那么一晚。
原因很简单，他没钱…
一想起昨天他说自己没钱，然后露露一脸大方的说‘睡觉的钱就包在我身上’的时候，旅馆老板看自己那一脸鄙视的模样，无言就恨不得找个地缝钻进去。
才刚走出旅馆，无言就看到了整装待发的露露一行人。
只见露露一个箭步来到他的身边，不满的嘟着小脸说道：“好慢啊…睡那么久，真像猪一样。”
无言闻言不禁翻了翻白眼，这样已经算是很早的了，以前在家里宅的时候，可是一觉睡到大中午的，哪有现在这样，一大清早的就起床。
“无言先生，接下来您是怎么打算的？听丽露说，您好像没有地方可以去的样子…”其实露露跟菲菲说的是，无言是从山里面出来的野人，出来寻食然后迷路了的，只不过被菲菲充分美化了而已。
“对啊，无言，你接下来要去哪？要不跟我回家吧！”听到露露的发言无言脸色顿时一垮，什么叫做跟我回家吧，你是出来找山寨夫人的土匪大王吗？
菲菲则是有点愕然的看着露露，露露这好像是第一次邀请别人到自己家去吧…
而无言心中沉思着，说真的，他还真没考虑过要上哪去，他一个来到异世才一个月的宅，就算在自己家里的时候都不曾出过多远的门，更别说在这个完全没有依靠的异世界了。
“我去佣兵工会那里看看吧。”想了一会，无言只能这么说道，虽然跟着露露也不失为一个好办法，但是那样是不是吃软饭先不说，首先自己就没有了升级的机会，虽然得到经验的方法也不是一定要把对方杀掉，但是找人练一场这样的情况，不是真正的战斗，无言也得不到一丁点的经验，这个系统可是很机灵的…
而且，自己以后肯定是还要召唤一些二次元妹子的，要是跟在露露的身边，到时候平白多出一个大活人，或许露露这里还能忽悠过去，但是菲菲那里却是怎么也解释不来的。
所以，当一名佣兵是最好的办法了，即可以得到赏金，又可以升级刷点，而且十分的自由。
“无言先生是打算当一名佣兵吗？”菲菲了然的点了点头，要是对方真的像露露说的那样，没有一点去处，那么当佣兵的确是个好办法。
“啊，怎么这样，呐，跟我回家难道不好吗？”好吧，其实还有反对的人。
露露对无言这么一个神神秘秘的家伙可是抱着充分的好奇心的，对于她来说，无言就是一个打发时间的好玩伴啊，这么一个好玩的‘东西’就这么走了，露露心里有点不情愿。
对于露露的想法，无言不知道，但是无言有预感，跟在露露的身边，准没好事！
“小姐！”
突然，一支大概百来人左右的骑兵小队出现在无言等人的不远处，领头的是一个看起来跟无言差不多大的男人，身穿一身虽然不是金闪闪但却十分**的铠甲，腰间那宽大的骑士宝剑在无言看来，拿去卖的价值多过拿去砍的价值。

斯莱目：（25级）
除了他之外，他身后的那些骑士兵们则是十几级上下，虽然人数比较多，但是实力却是普遍比露露的护卫低上一个层次。
也不知道是为什么，当看到这个斯莱目的时候，无言感觉自己可能会有一点麻烦。
在一阵‘锵锵锵’的脚步声后，斯莱目就带着一群骑兵来到露露的面前，对着露露说道：“小姐，浮空艇已经准备完毕，随时都可以出发了！”
“你为什么会出现在这里啊？”露露稍微有点不满的说道，刚才她可是绞尽脑汁，想出一大堆话来，打算把无言留住，谁知道，却被这个突然杀出来的斯莱目给打断了，害得她好不容易想出来的‘好点子’全部忘得一干二净。
少女哟，你还是省点心，想想中午吃什么比较实在…
“丽露，他们是你父亲派来护送你回家的，我也是昨天才接到消息…”菲菲虽然陪在露露身边很长一段时间了，但是对于这个时常天然的少女，菲菲有时候也不知道她在想什么，也不知道她怎么突然就不高兴起来了，当下，只能苦笑的说道。
“爸爸也真是的，人家又不是小孩子…”
要是我是你老爸，也会担心你这个半天然系少女会不会迷路…

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s copyright complaint fast track. The next day, Wuyan walked out of the hotel after washing up.
To be honest, Wu Yan actually wished he had not stayed in this hotel for one night.
The reason is simple, he has no money...
Thinking back to yesterday when he said he had no money, and then said generously, "The money for sleeping is all on me." The hotel owner saw the look of contempt on his face, and he was speechless and wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl in.
As soon as he walked out of the hotel, Wu Yan saw Lulu and his party getting ready to go.
Lulu came to him with a quick stride, and said with a dissatisfied face: "It's so slow...she looks like a pig after sleeping for so long."
Wu Yan couldn't help but roll his eyes when he heard this. It was already very early. When he stayed at home, he would sleep until noon. How could he get up early in the morning like this?
"Mr. Wuyan, what are your plans next? I heard from Lilu that you seem to have nowhere to go..." In fact, what Lulu told Feifei was that Wuyan was a savage who came out of the mountains, went out to look for food and got lost. It was just fully beautified by Feifei.
"That's right, Wu Yan, where are you going next? Why don't you come home with me!" Wu Yan's face suddenly fell when he heard Lulu's speech. What do you mean, come home with me? Are you the bandit king who came out to find the cottage lady?
Feifei looked at Lulu in shock. This seemed to be the first time Lulu invited someone to her home...
Wu Yan pondered in his heart, to be honest, he really hadn't thought about where to go. He had only been in a different world for a month, and he had never gone far even when he was at home, let alone in this different world where he had no support at all.
"Let me go to the mercenary union and have a look." After thinking for a while, Wu Yan could only say this. Although following Lulu was also a good idea, let's not talk about whether it would be a soft meal. First of all, he would not have the chance to upgrade. Although the way to gain experience is not necessarily to kill the opponent, but finding someone to practice such a situation is not a real battle, and Wu Yan can't get any experience. This system is very clever...
Moreover, I will definitely summon some two-dimensional girls in the future. If I follow Lulu, there will be an extra living person for nothing. Maybe Lulu can fool her, but Feifei can't explain it.
Therefore, becoming a mercenary is the best way. You can get bounties, upgrade and earn points, and it is very free.
"Mr. Wu Yan, are you planning to become a mercenary?" Feifei nodded clearly. If the other party really has no place to go as Lulu said, then becoming a mercenary is indeed a good idea.
"Ah, why is it like this? Now, wouldn't it be nice to come home with me?" Well, there are actually some people who object to it.
Lulu was fully curious about such a mysterious guy as Wu Yan. For her, Wu Yan was a good playmate to pass the time. With such a fun 'thing' gone like this, Lulu felt a little reluctant.
Wu Yan didn't know what Lulu was thinking, but Wu Yan had a hunch that following Lulu would be bad!
"Miss!"
Suddenly, a cavalry squad of about a hundred people appeared not far from Wu Yan and others. The leader was a man who looked about the same age as Wu Yan. He was wearing a suit of armor that was not shiny but very elegant. The broad knight's sword on his waist was worth more to sell than to chop it down.
Slim: (Level 25)
Apart from him, the cavalry soldiers behind him were around ten levels. Although they were larger in number, their strength was generally one level lower than Lulu's guards.
I don't know why,When seeing this Sli goal, Wu Yan felt that he might be in a little trouble.
After a burst of footsteps, Slaim led a group of cavalry to Lulu and said to Lulu: "Miss, the aerostat is ready and can set off at any time!"
"Why are you here?" Lulu said with a little dissatisfaction. Just now, she racked her brains and came up with a lot of words to keep Wu Yan away. Who knows, but she was interrupted by Slim who suddenly came out, causing her to forget all the 'good ideas' she finally came up with.
Girl, you'd better save some time and think about what to eat for lunch...
"Lilu, they were sent by your father to escort you home. I only received the news yesterday..." Although Feifei has been with Lulu for a long time, for this often natural girl, Feifei sometimes doesn't know what she is thinking, and she doesn't know why she suddenly became unhappy. At the moment, Feifei could only say with a wry smile.
"Dad, it's true, I'm not a child..."
If I were your dad, I would also worry about whether a semi-natural girl like you would get lost...
